title: Review of c06's pcell contained heredity: on fresh seed 5 all 64 cell deaths are below the median yield, r = 0.84, particles held >= 89x
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 5: c06's genealogy.py to T=100000, contain.py to T=20000, and a labkit pack (T=100000). Genealogy: 28 persistent splits, generation 5, 0 merges, 65 cell deaths, 22 cells at the end. deathsel.py: 64/64 deaths below the median living yield (mean percentile 0.039; 39/39 for cells seen >= 20 snapshots, 0.026); splitting parents at percentile 0.63 (19/27 above the median). The inert marker z gives death percentile 0.70 (10/64 below the median), i.e. no low-z bias but not uniform either. heredity.py: parent-daughter yield r = 0.835 over 54 daughters (mean |diff| 0.025 vs living sd 0.10). contain.py: every cell holds its particles at >= 89x the 2-6 px shell at every check, 93.5% of particles inside cells at t=20000. particles.png: white low-yield cells stay small and vanish while cyan cells grow and divide; the outside is empty of particles.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/particles.png t=0: particles uniform over the domain
observations.W: data/c_world_s5.log: min ratio 89-195x at every check, 93.5% of particles inside cells
observations.D: data/gen_s5.log: 28 persistent splits, max generation 5, 0 merges
observations.H: data/selection_s5.txt: 64/64 deaths below median yield (mean pct 0.039) vs marker 0.70; data/heredity_s5.txt parent-daughter r 0.835

controls_run.H: data/selection_s5.txt key zm: the identical-event inert marker in the same run

verdicts.limitation: W holds by construction: particles take a Brownian step that is accepted with probability (phi_new/phi_old)^2, so they cannot leave the inside phase except at the wall; the gate-off ablation kills the cells rather than releasing contents, as c06 says. H: the trait is continuous and 'kinds' are yield ranks; the inert marker is not neutral on this seed (death percentile 0.70, biased the other way), so the null is noisier than uniform. Mean yield change was not measured here. I did not re-run the lowered-D or 1.5x arms.
